name: Guijuelo (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, red above and below and blue at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Guijuelo (a beehive on blue within a bordure of bees and oak branches).
history: The arms of Guijuelo were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 14 April 1958; the municipal flag was approved on 31 January 2001 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 9 March 2001: a square cloth of proportion 1:1 divided per saltire into four parts, with the crowned arms of the town of Guijuelo superimposed at the centre.
